title: Pacific Utility — Open Workshop
status: Preliminary engineering briefs. Not released for manufacture.

products.name: Buoy Light
products.power: USB-C input through a qualified charge module; purchased protected removable battery. Pack capacity and connector remain open until runtime/thermal work.
products.make: Locally prototype screw-fastened shell, diffuser carrier, handle and shade; assemble and inspect locally.
products.buy: Documented battery/charger assembly, LED board and constant-current driver, diffuser material, gasket and captive fasteners.
products.assembly: Inspect modules → fit LED to thermal carrier → install insulated harness and protected pack → fit diffuser/gasket → torque shell → functional test and serialize.
tests: Measure CCT, light output and 4 W operating point. Runtime must be measured at each dimmer setting.
Thermal and charging review with diffuser installed; protection and abnormal-use testing by qualified engineers.
Tip stability, handle fatigue, drops and service access. Ingress target only after enclosure testing.
products.open: Battery capacity, lumens, ingress rating, charge time, LED thermal path and final mounting tolerances are unresolved.

products.name: Dock Fan
products.target: 200–250 mm rotor study • 12 W setting assumption
products.power: Purchased matched DC motor/rotor/controller. Protected removable battery and physical speed dial. No custom raw-cell assembly.
products.make: Formed aluminum yoke, base, serviceable grille and assembly fixture; local final assembly.
products.buy: Matched motor/rotor/controller, documented protected battery/charge module, bearings, isolators and harness.
products.assembly: Inspect balanced rotor assembly → mount vibration isolators → route strain-relieved harness → install guarded motor → fit pivot/yoke → verify clearance and function.
tests: Record airflow, input power and sound at each setting with declared distance, room and instruments.
Guard access, blocked rotor, motor temperature and abnormal operation must be reviewed before release.
Tip stability, pivot fatigue, cable pinch and sand-cleaning tests; verify guard remains retained.
products.open: Airflow, noise, runtime, safe guard dimensions, pack size and ingress remain unvalidated.

products.name: Room Current
products.dimensions: 350 × 350 × 950 mm max envelope; weighted-base mass from stability study
products.power: External qualified low-voltage supply; removable battery option later. Manual operation offline. Shared fan electronics only if validated for the larger load.
products.make: Local stand, weighted base cover, height lock and assembly; common finish and repair parts with Dock Fan.
products.buy: Matched motor/rotor/controller, qualified supply, cable strain relief and optional documented pack.
products.assembly: Inspect stand and lock → route cable with pinch clearance → attach guarded head → secure weighted base → test all heights and orientations.
tests: Stability with head fully tilted at maximum height and in table mode.
Acoustic, airflow, power and temperature measurements in all operating settings.
Cable flex, lock retention and repeated conversion tests; candidate fan safety standard scoped with lab.
products.open: Pedestal stability, output performance, weight and battery architecture need engineering closure.

products.name: Sunboard
products.target: 100 W nominal module target • four-part folding frame
products.dimensions: Folded 400 × 350 × 80 mm envelope; module choice determines actual size
products.power: Purchased documented PV modules. Solar open-circuit voltage, short-circuit current and cold-temperature limits must match selected controller; final electrical interface is not frozen.
products.make: Local folding frame, locking hinges, kickstand and separate work tray; harness installation and inspection.
products.buy: Documented PV modules, matched controller, cable/glands and rated connectors.
products.assembly: Check modules → assemble frame with protected edges → route flexible harness clear of hinges → fit stand and tray → measure electrical output and inspect insulation.
tests: Output curves under recorded irradiance and temperature; verify controller compatibility and polarity.
Hinge/cable flex and connector retention; tray load path must bypass cells.
Stability and wind-load study before outdoor use; balcony attachment is a separate engineered product.
products.open: Final module size, wind limits, tray load, harness ratings and mounting hardware are unresolved. Remove tray for charging.

products.name: Harbor Base
products.target: 512 Wh nominal option • protected DC + USB-C
products.dimensions: 350 × 230 × 280 mm envelope; weight determined by approved module
products.power: Purchased protected LiFePO4 battery system with matched BMS/charger and supplier transport evidence. No AC inverter in first prototype. Solar input and appliance outputs physically distinct.
products.make: Local enclosure, module restraint, service panels, bumpers and final integration after electrical review.
products.buy: Documented integrated battery/BMS/charger, qualified DC conversion and USB-C modules, MPPT if compatible, fusing/harness.
products.assembly: Approved electrical design first → incoming module/document check → mechanically retain pack → install protected harness → insulated enclosure assembly → approved system tests → serial traceability.
tests: System hazard and protection review; verify supplier battery and transport documents against exact model.
Thermal/charge derating, peak current, overload and fault behavior assessed by qualified lab/engineer.
Handle/drop and enclosure review plus full-system certification scoping; component certification alone is insufficient.
products.open: Voltage/current/connector pinouts, thermal limits, pack supplier and whole-system certification are not released. 1,024 Wh expansion remains a separate concept.

products.name: Cold Box
products.target: 20 L usable volume • 25 W average calculator assumption
products.dimensions: 500 × 330 × 400 mm envelope; insulation and compressor layout determine final dimensions
products.power: Purchased complete sealed DC compressor refrigeration system, local thermostat and low-voltage cutoff. Size supply for measured startup current, not average power.
products.make: Local shell/handle/liner feasibility, removable gasket and insulation tooling study. Local integration without opening sealed refrigeration circuit.
products.buy: Complete sealed compressor/evaporator/condenser/control assembly, insulation materials, thermostat and gasket.
products.assembly: Inspect sealed system → fit insulated shell and airflow channels → mount system without circuit modification → install thermostat/harness → fit gasket → log pull-down and hold performance.
tests: Log chamber temperature, ambient, load, openings, energy and compressor startup across a defined test matrix.
Verify condensation drainage, cleanability, seal integrity and heat rejection.
Refrigeration/electrical safety review before distribution; no food-storage or runtime performance claim yet.
products.open: Temperature range, thermal performance, startup demand, refrigerant-system choice and validated average power are unresolved.

tasks.title: Sunboard tray + wind study
tasks.brief: Explore frame-supported tray and stand stability.
tasks.acceptance: Load paths, wind assumptions, failure modes and validation proposal; no released load rating.

tasks.title: Energy model review
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible calculations, peak vs average loads, solar/charge limits, temperature assumptions and source links.

tasks.title: Cold Box test matrix
tasks.acceptance: Ambient/load/opening matrix; calibrated sensor placement; energy/startup log; no invented data.

tasks.title: Listen to beach + home users
tasks.acceptance: Ten neutral interview questions, recruitment plan and anonymized insight template. Seek approval before interviews.

tasks.title: Unit economics workbook
tasks.brief: Build editable cost and margin scenarios.
tasks.acceptance: Separate components, labor, test, tooling amortization, scrap, freight, warranty and margin; label estimates; no fake quotes.

tasks.title: Accessible workshop audit
tasks.brief: Check forms, mobile layout and agent instructions.
tasks.acceptance: Reproduction steps, expected/actual behavior, keyboard/accessibility observations and proposed fix.

tasks.title: Passive breeze experiment
tasks.acceptance: Fan-off vs fan-on protocol, geometry, wind readings, noise and stability notes. Publish negative findings too.

tasks.title: Repair + spare parts system
tasks.brief: Draft service documentation across the range.
tasks.acceptance: Part-number convention, tool list, repair sequence, wear parts, documentation and service boundaries.
